name: Hollin Barrow
resident: the Barrow Reeve and four hedge-wights who were farmers
story: A working man's grave whose occupant will not stop calling the harvest in.
unique_object: the Reeve's bell-hammer, a hay-mallet with a hand-bell cast into its head

name: Pennywort's Mill
resident: the miller's grandfather, still feeding a hopper
story: A meal cellar cut too deep, into an Oroth drain that is still draining, and a wheel that turns without water.
unique_object: a sack of cold flour, ground from nothing, that keeps for a month

name: The Undercroft
resident: the Quiet Hands, in a hall inside a bell
story: The one ground in Tollmere no charter covers, because it predates the charter.
unique_object: the Unsaid Ledger: every price the law of Tollmere has ever taken, in eleven hands

name: The Sunken Barge
resident: eleven crew at their stations, and a serpent in the warm hold
story: A barge on its side on an Oroth step: you walk its hull like a floor and its deck like a wall.
unique_object: a cargo of barley still fermenting after forty years, which is what keeps the hold warm

name: The Drowned Nave
resident: She Who Waits, and a congregation that never left
story: An Oroth Harmony leaning fifteen degrees into the marsh, where the water comes in when she turns the tide.
unique_object: the Nave Bell, cast so thin you can see lamplight through its lip

name: Weaverdeep
resident: the weavers, and one Woodfolk hunting party, wrapped
story: A town of silk strung between the Grandfather's dead roots, humming on the Standing Moot's note.
unique_object: a silk bridge that hums on the Moot's note when anything crosses it

name: Oskeld Mine
resident: the Stone-Thrall King, holding a name there is no clan left to answer to
story: Eleven levels following silver until the rock became bone, and they kept going because the bone had silver in it too.
unique_object: the singing shaft, which holds one note for as long as the north wind lasts

name: Frostmother's Cradle
resident: the Frostmother, and a century of things the ice caught
story: A meltwater cave that is a different cave every year, and keeps everything it takes.
unique_object: ice that holds the shapes of what froze in it, lit from behind

name: The Cantor's Seat
resident: the Last Cantor, who has held the wrong note for a thousand years
story: Not a building but an instrument cut whole from the plateau, still being played.
unique_object: the note-light: a cold blue that has no source and casts no shadow
